What AI now charges to do each job, in tokens, $, log scale
Each figure is one documented public case, not a market average. Finding a flaw: the per-bug cost of autonomous agents on real
open-source bugs in an academic test (CyberGym), from cents with a cheap model to about $8 with a frontier one. Breaking in: the
tokens Hacktron spent reaching OpenAI's internal code over two months. The exploit chain: XBOW's API bill for a full-chain Chrome
attack, which Google later rewarded with its top bounty. These are only the automated parts of an attack; much of the rest is still
Sources: Lu et al., CyberGym (2026); Hacktron; XBOW; author's compilation
